# arc frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:arcFrame`](gmeow-arcFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/arcFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The narrative reference frame within which this arc is interpreted. Functional: one frame per [`CharacterArc`](../classes/gmeow-CharacterArc.md); cross-continuity arcs are separate instances linked by [`counterpartOf`](gmeow-counterpartOf.md).
